description: Record of how value lists were migrated (October 2026): migrations 1 and 2 moved lists onto schemas/common.schema.json; migration 3 renamed the remaining domain-specific values to camelCase (sharedDefinition is null); migration 4 (after the website review) camelCased Strategy empathyIntegrationLevel, put the coverage domain fields on the shared domainType list, and turned Trigger primaryCategory from free text into a list. For each field: the shared definition it now uses, how each previous value was mapped, and any values kept as domain-specific additions. Use it to convert existing data. Paths are as they were at the time of each migration.
